conclusion: This dispute involves a clearly documented time and materials contract for BD KPI Dashboard development where Forge Outdoors refuses to pay $10,877.63 for 73.25 hours of documented professional services. Overwhelming evidence supports The Waffle Co. Every potential Forge defense is contradicted by documentary evidence. Client's own statements (particularly July 24 meeting) are fatal to claims. Characterization of debt as 'unfounded' not supported by facts. Legal position appears pretextual for avoiding legitimate payment obligation. Most Significant Evidence: Adrian Trimmer's July 24, 2025 explicit statements confirming (1) work met specifications, (2) time and materials payment basis, and (3) client data responsibility.
